scheme_name: Financial Assistance for the Marriage of Daughters of Widows/Destitute Women belonging to the Scheduled Caste
other_conditions: Bride's mother must belong to the Scheduled Caste community.
Financial assistance is available for up to two daughters per family.
Assistance is only for the first marriage of each daughter.
Applicant must have lived in Chandigarh for at least three years.
If both parents are deceased, the legal guardian can apply.
benefits_summary: A grant of ₹20,000 per daughter for marriage.
